description:
Alvarado Palace sits in Las Merindades, in the north of Burgos province, a region with a high concentration of medieval towers and palaces tied to Castilian noble lineages. Guest reviews repeatedly describe the building as a well-preserved "old palace," personally managed by a couple of owners who receive consistent praise for their close attention to guests and knowledge of the area.

Today its rooms offer mountain views, including suites and a suite with a hydromassage bathtub.

The palace's setting within Las Merindades, a region historically dense with noble towers and palaces, ties Alvarado directly to Castile's medieval landed-gentry architecture.

The owners' personal, hands-on management style, repeatedly highlighted in guest reviews, distinguishes Alvarado from larger, more standardized hotel operations.

The palace's position in a lesser-visited corner of northern Burgos gives guests staying here access to a genuinely rural stretch of Castile and León, away from the region's more heavily touristed circuits.
